title: Plan views and lineup edit cover the architect

sections.heading: Why
sections.body: S08 relay later notes. The architect is in the engine and the plan, but it is missing from the plan displays: internal/cli/run.go:145, internal/tui/launch.go:304 and internal/tui/waves.go:380; run.plan still refuses an architect lineup override (internal/daemon/runs.go ~302) although adj 151 (lineup-only) expects the owner can add or drop it with the S83 editor; docs/design.md:169-170 says the plan shows whether it runs an architect; docs/glossary.md:205-206 omits the architect state. Open for the owner: for a matched architect row with no ork adapter, planning refuses (fail closed, today) or drops the architect; the architect recommends keeping refuse. This touches UI, so it gets the UI pass (rule u10).

sections.heading: Files
sections.body:
- `internal/cli/run.go:145`, `internal/tui/launch.go:304`, `internal/tui/waves.go:380`: show the architect in the plan, confirm and Waves lineup column.
- `internal/tui/lineup.go`: let the S83 editor add or drop the architect row.
- `internal/daemon/runs.go` (~302): accept an architect override in run.plan and wave.start.
- Tests beside each, and `testdata/golden/` for changed views.
- `docs/design.md:169-170`, `docs/glossary.md:205-206`, `docs/dashboard.md` (lineup editor).

sections.heading: Failing tests
sections.body:
- TestPlanTextShowsTheArchitectRow: ork run and the TUI confirm list the architect when the lineup has one, and nothing when it does not.
- TestLineupEditorCanAddAndDropTheArchitect: the S83 editor adds or drops the architect and re-plans.
- TestRunPlanAcceptsAnArchitectOverride: run.plan with an architect override returns it; an architect with no adapter is refused (fail closed, the recommended default, until the owner decides).
- Golden views, colour and monochrome.

sections.heading: Implement
sections.body: 1. Write the failing tests first. 2. Show the architect row in the three plan displays. 3. Let the editor and the daemon accept an architect override. 4. Keep refusing a matched architect row with no adapter (fail closed). 5. Update the docs. 6. go test ./internal/tui -update, then review the golden diff. This is a UI slice: it gets the UI pass (r14, rule u10).

sections.heading: Check
sections.body:
- go test -race -count=1 ./internal/cli ./internal/tui ./internal/daemon
- go test -race -count=1 ./...
- go vet ./...
- gofmt -l .
- go test ./internal/tui -update, then review the golden diff
- slicer check
- adj lint
